# LuaSPortSensor:pushFrame

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Push a S.Port frame.

```lua
local result = sensor:pushFrame(frame)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frame` | [LuaSPortFrame](../../objects/LuaSPortFrame/index.md) | yes | or table {module, band, rx, physId, primId, appId, value} |

## Returns

result (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
sensor:pushFrame({module=0, band=0, rx=0, physId=0x1B, primId=0x30, appId=0x6800, value=0x80})
```
